name: Anime.js scrambleText parameters
description: Official Anime.js documentation demo: scrambleText parameters.

codeSnippet.source: Transition between different text.
Define which characters appear during the scramble animation.
Controls the starting appearance of the text before the scramble animation begins.
Apply easing functions to control the acceleration and deceleration of the scramble reveal wave.
Display a cursor character at the leading edge of the reveal wave as it moves through each character.
Higher values make the reveal wave move faster.
Add a delay in milliseconds before the reveal wave starts within the scramble animation.
Control how many times per second characters cycle through random values during the scramble phase.
Define how long each character spends scrambling before settling into its final settled value.
Add a delay in milliseconds before the scramble animation starts.
Override the auto-computed animation duration with a specific value in milliseconds for precise control.
Add random timing offsets to each character for a more organic and less uniform reveal effect.
Control where the reveal wave starts from, whether left, center, right, or a specific character index.
The animation flows in the opposite direction of the specified from value.
Set a seed value for the random number generator.
